item.text: A Schwarz P sheet cell at 30% solid meets both stiffness limits in the tool’s search estimates: \(E_{[100]}=10.43\) GPa and \(C_{44}=7.34\) GPa. The atlas also reports positive pessimistic margins. This session provides search estimates only, so the design is not certified.

item.text: Released a Ti-6Al-4V Schwarz P TPMS sheet cell at 30% solid volume. Estimated homogenized \(E_{[100]}=10.43\) GPa and \(C_{44}=7.34\) GPa meet both stiffness targets within the 35% volume limit. These are search estimates; the design is not certified.
